ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80% low-intensity (black/dark grey) to 20% high-intensity (white/light grey) across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity base. Right lobe contains a large, irregular high-intensity mottled region in the mid-to-lower section. Multiple discrete high-intensity focal spots are scattered across the upper half of the right lobe. Left lobe is near-uniformly low-intensity with minimal high-intensity pixels at the distal tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an internal angle of approximately 85 degrees and a vertical depth of ~10% of the maximum fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular trailing edge boundary with high-frequency micro-serrations. Significant pixel-level jaggedness observed on both lobes, with more pronounced indentations on the right lobe's medial edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature from the median notch to the lateral tips. The right lobe exhibits a steeper upward sweep compared to the left lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of several small (3-10 pixel diameter) circular high-intensity clusters localized on the dark background of the right lobe's upper quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Highly irregular, high-intensity textured clusters at both lateral lobe tips. The right lobe trailing edge shows a distinct non-linear indentation ~1/3 from the tip towards the notch.
